cursor.encoding: opaque Base64URL encoding of last numeric id; malformed cursor -> validation error

commonHttpBehavior.auth: JWT Authorization: Bearer <token>; stateless; roles USER/ADMIN. Secure routes do not read a user ID from request bodies.

cors.consequence: CorsConfig does not expose Location; browser JS on a different origin may receive a 201 response but cannot read Location unless the server adds Access-Control-Expose-Headers. Do not infer body id for current create because response body is empty.
cors.disallowedOrigin: 403 text/plain Invalid CORS request; browser hides the response body.

requestClientReuseEvidence.scope: fixed eight main-board post recipes from course-api-contracts.mjs

features.captureId: yes; validates same-origin Location /api/posts/{positive integer}; manual id provenance is explicitly not server-verified

consolidationNotes: Current source has 29 annotated application-controller routes plus GET /actuator/health, yielding the spec-v2 total of 30. /api/start/ping appears in legacy setup instructions, not in current board-server Controller mappings.

Main board-server POST /api/posts returns 201, empty body, and Location. The legacy create flow documents an id-bearing response body with boardSlug/visibility fields; do not reuse that response contract for the main API.
Current like PUT/DELETE are 204 empty body; legacy scenario flow says 200 and body postId/liked/likeCount.
Current GET /api/posts uses cursor pagination and optional keyword/tag/sort; legacy GET /api/boards/{slug}/posts uses page/size and boardSlug.
Current board-server has no multipart browser recipe. Its /api/admin/coupons/{couponId}/bulk-issue requires an XLSX multipart file; the three inspected clients have no file-upload control.
